finds.title: Antique Stromberg Carlson Telephone
finds.note: Stromberg-Carlson 1930s wood-cased art-deco desk set with oval slotted grille and bakelite handset (photo), $25, "restoration project". Not in the entry; could be a scarce wood deco model ($150-300) or a radio-cabinet conversion. Ask for the model/tag inside the case and whether dial, ringer and cord are present; buy only if a complete, tagged Stromberg-Carlson set

finds.title: Vintage Barbie doll case
finds.note: 1965 Mattel Barbie/Francie/Skipper trunk (SPP) + 2nd case. Empty $25–45; with 1960s dolls/mod clothes $100–700 (lots sold $702–911). ASK: open both cases, photos of contents.

finds.title: Vintage Spear Fishing Decoys
finds.note: 14 handmade fish spearing decoys, $20 ea / $225 lot. Sold handmade decoys median $35-45 ea. At $225 lot profit ~$200 (< $225 needed). Offer $150 for all 14 -> profit ~$275. Tier C (offer)

finds.title: Three antique knives
finds.note: Three jigged-bone folders: two Germany-made (stockman and pen pattern with shield) and one USA stag-handled folding hunter. $35 for three; if tang stamps read Boker Tree Brand, Puma, Hen & Rooster or Western/Schrade USA, each is $40-70. Ask for tang stamp photos of all three

finds.title: Vintage 1960’s Bossons Heads
finds.note: 24 Bossons (Congleton, England) chalkware heads, 1960s; body: $5 each or $100 the set, some small chips. Terapeak singles median $16–22, mixed lots $67–140. Sold singly (buyer pays ship) ~$360–480 gross → ~$200+ profit at $100 but 24 listings; as 3–4 themed sets less. ASK: back stamps, which have chips; offer ~$75 for all.

finds.title: *Antique fiddle bow*
finds.note: Nickel-mounted (wire winding, plain ebony frog) trade violin bow, 29.5in, 48.8g, seller says "maybe Mirecourt 1920s" with no proof. Unstamped trade-bow tier $100-300 (low end $100, no comp) gives about -$8 profit at $75. Ask: is there a maker stamp on the stick just above the frog (photo), is the stick pernambuco, is it straight/uncracked; offer about $35-40 unstamped; buy at $75 only if stamped Mirecourt/German workshop.

finds.title: Vintage Hummel Figurines
finds.note: Terapeak: TMK-2 full-bee singles median $25 (p25 $17, p75 $45, n=49). 20 × ~$25–30 → ~$500–600 gross sold singly; at $200 profit ≈ $200–250 after fees/inbound ship (buyers pay outbound) → Tier B, labor 20 listings, fragile. Offer $200 (cap). ASK: base marks + model numbers (larger/rarer models like Chimney Sweep 12, Angel Serenade push it up).

finds.title: Vintage PUMA Pocket knife
finds.note: Puma 230365 lockback w/ box, $50. One NOS comp $173; Puma boxed lockbacks median $150. Profit $38-65 -> borderline Tier C; ask if unused

finds.title: Vintage Hoppalong Cassidy watch
finds.note: 1950 US Time Hopalong Cassidy watch, untested, $25 porch pickup. Running loose $50–100; with saddle box $200+. ASK: does it run when wound; box?

finds.title: Razor Collection Vintage
finds.note: 8-piece razor collection, $50 OBO cash pickup (Westbrook): Gillette Tech in maroon case; gold Gillette Old Type in case w/ Rexall blades; gold Gillette in 'Chrome' labelled box; gold Gillette in purple-lined case; Rolls Razor in case; Durham Duplex boxed; 2 straight razors (one in 'U.S.'-stamped case). Parted out ~$200-250. Ask: will you ship (pickup-only) or can a local hold it; confirm head markings/date codes, blades not rusted, straight razor makers. Offer $50 shipped.

finds.title: Antique Post Cards VINTAGE
finds.note: ~65+ mostly 1905-1940s cards (divided-back art, valentines, a few RPPCs incl. crowd scene and man at shack) at $35, "huge collection". Ask: total count, how many real-photo cards, any Halloween/holiday. At 65 cards ~$0.54/card exceeds $0.25 rule; works only if 150+ cards or several good RPPCs. No comp; est low-end

finds.title: Vintage Lighters
finds.note: Six Zippo-style lighters (one Michael Waltrip #15 NASCAR Zippo, one engraved Zippo, one ribbed Park-type, brass trench/tube lighter, Ronson flints box). Value hinges on bottom stamps: a Zippo with "PAT. 2032695" and 4-barrel hinge (1937-50) or "PAT. PEND." 3-barrel sells $50-150 each; 1970s+ date-coded bottoms $10-15. Ask for a photo of every bottom stamp. As-is lot est. $60 (no comp) -> profit ~$2; only buy if a pre-1950 bottom shows. Tier C.

finds.title: Vintage Radio’s
finds.note: Listing is the Panasonic RF-689 radio ($10, kill on its own) but the photo shows a Led Zeppelin II LP, Atlantic SD 8236, in shrink, in the background. Not listed for sale. Ask: is the LP for sale, and do the dead-wax runouts show "RL" and "SS" (Robert Ludwig hot-mix first press, sells $150-400) or a later "PR"/"MO" cut (~$20-30). Price only matters with the RL etch. (no comp)

finds.title: Vintage Plastic Bracelets
finds.note: Eight thin translucent amber/butterscotch spacer bangles + one bright-yellow faceted bangle. Only matters if they are Bakelite (phenolic): translucent "apple juice"/butterscotch Bakelite spacers sell $15-30 each, celluloid/Lucite copies $2-5. Ask seller: hot-water test - rub or run under hot water, Bakelite smells of formaldehyde/camphor-free; also "is $25 for all nine?" Est. $80 as a Bakelite lot (no comp); profit ~$80x0.87-8-25 = $37 -> only a lot-price offer of $15 passes. Tier C.

finds.title: Fender guitar/bass strap. Vintage
finds.note: 1970s Fender monogram strap (brown/gold woven, Fender script logos, leather ends, brass slider). Fraying at the lower end. At $15, vintage 70s monogram straps resell ~$60-100. Ask for photos of the other leather end and the back, and the full length. Buy if both ends are intact. Offer $15 shipped or less.

finds.title: Vintage tryolean purse
finds.note: Photo: 1950s box purse - tortoise Lucite lid and arch handle on a pierced chrome-filigree metal body. Lucite-lid metal box bags sell ~$60-150; Rialto/Wilardy/Patricia of Miami marked up to $200+. At $40 profit only clears $50 if resale >= ~$130. Ask: photo of inside lid/frame for a maker stamp (Rialto, Wilardy, Charles S. Kahn, Dorset Rex), cracks at hinges, interior lining; offer $25 shipped-ready.

finds.title: Vintage Ultraman Shirt
finds.note: Ultraman Gaia graphic tee, heather charcoal, propaganda-poster art with Tsuburaya 1998 copyright line, est 2XL-3XL. Could be 1998-99 Japan/US official merch ($80-150) or 2000s licensed reprint ($20-35). Ask: photo of neck tag and hem (single vs double stitch), where/when bought. Buy at $30 only if tag is a late-90s blank (Hanes Beefy/Fruit/Japanese Printstar) with single stitch.

finds.title: Antique Hampden pocket watch
finds.note: Dueber-Hampden hunter-case watch, white enamel Roman dial, gold-filled-looking case, c.1895-1910; seller says it runs then stops (needs service). As non-runner GF it's $50-80 = no profit. Ask for a photo of the inside back lid stamp: buy at $40 only if 10K/14K solid (gold value $600+); if GF/'warranted', pass.

finds.title: Antique/ vintage copper drawer pulls + hinges
finds.note: photo: matching set of 1940s hammered copper-finish steel arrowhead strap hinges (38) + 25 bail pulls from a 1948 house; restorer demand for full matching sets; ask maker mark on back (Amerock/National Lock), weight/total count, rust; offer ~$35 shipped-ready

finds.title: 2 OLD HAGGADAHS -MAGNIFICENT COLOR ILLUSTRATIONS
finds.note: Photos: (1) 7x9in all-Hebrew Szyk Haggadah (Arthur Szyk Seder scene, Four Sons panel, crowned Star of David pages) - a later Israeli (Massadah/Alumoth-type) edition; (2) 8.5x12 Shulsinger Bros 1949 Haggadah illus. Siegmund Forst (1961 printing). Est pair ~$100-140 (Szyk small edition $60-100, Forst $20-40; no comps, low confidence). At $100 fails (profit ~-$8). ASK: photo of the Szyk title/colophon page (publisher, year, any limited/numbered or larger format), will ship Media Mail; offer $40 shipped-ready (profit ~$52 at $120 resale). Kill if a 1980s+ small reprint at $100 firm.

finds.title: Snap-on tools miscellaneous
finds.note: Snap-on lot: ~15 combination/flare/flex-head wrenches (several stamped "Snap-on USA", SAE + metric), flex-head socket wrenches, deep sockets, spinner, speed handle and a partial C-260A punch/chisel roll (~10 of ~26 tools). Parted out ~$300 (wrenches $12-30, flex-heads $30-45). At $125 profit ~ $100 < $125 required. Offer $80; ask that all wrenches are Snap-on stamped (not Blue-Point/Craftsman) and whether the speed handle is Snap-on. At $80 profit = 300*.87-20-15-80 = ~$146.

finds.title: Antique Brass Bowl. 19th Century Persian
finds.note: Tier B (thin comps): cast/engraved Persian-Islamic bronze bowl w/ calligraphy band, 4.5in, $49 SF. Sold Islamic calligraphy bronze bowls $120-250 (n=3). Profit ~$80. Risk: modern Afghan repro - ask for base photo / patina inside foot

finds.title: Limoges T&V Art Deco Vase
finds.note: T&V Limoges 8" trumpet vase, stylized iris + gold, c.1905–15. Only T&V blank (amateur): $60–120 pass. Pickard/Stouffer studio mark: $250–450. ASK: sharp base photo.

finds.title: Vintage Green Cameo Uranium Depression Glass Vase
finds.note: Green Hocking Cameo (Ballerina) footed vase ~6" — sold $85–220, median ~$100. Works only at ~$25–35 and no chips. ASK: height, chips, offer $30.

finds.title: Vintage 1970's Choker Necklaces
finds.note: ~12 1970s chains incl. snake/box chains possibly 925. 50 g sterling lot sold $131.70 (Sep 2026). ASK: clasp stamps (925/14K/GF), weight.

finds.title: Vintage Jostens women's Quartz Swiss Gold Tone Watch w/ Hadley band.
finds.note: GE-logo Jostens 21-jewel service-award watch titled quartz, $20 cash, Georgetown IN. Ask for case-back photos (14K vs 10K GF) and whether it runs. 14K → Tier A.

finds.title: Knives
finds.note: "Antique knife Marbles $55" in a Puma lot listing — ask for photo of blade etch/tang stamp (Marble's Gladstone MI) and length; Marble's Ideal pitted ~$80–150

finds.title: Vintage Brunton's Compass with Case
finds.note: Wm. Ainsworth & Sons D.W. Brunton pocket transit, aluminum, PAT JULY 20 1926, serial 16976, leather case, needle free, glass/mirror intact; owner engraving. Terapeak: Ainsworth transits median $99 (p75 $129), aluminum w/ case median $150. Resale ~$120–150 → profit ~$55–80 at $35 → Tier B. Littleton CO, cash only, landline — needs local pickup/proxy.

finds.title: Turquoise Jewelry
finds.note: Lot of turquoise jewelry 'starting @ $20': channel-inlay cuff (Zuni-style), inlay ring, needlepoint/stone rings, pin, big pendant. Ask: price per piece (esp. cuff and inlay ring), any sterling/maker hallmark on inside, weight in grams, and will ship. Cuff alone could resell $80-150 if hallmarked sterling.

finds.title: Vintage Vinyl LP Record Albums
finds.note: Seattle record seller, $10-20 each across ~80 LPs. Two punk/hardcore titles stand out: Heroin s/t LP (San Diego screamo, Gravity Records c.1993, skeleton cover) and Social Distortion "Live at the Roxy" LP (Time Bomb 1998); originals est. $60-150 each (general knowledge, no comps; reissues exist). Also JR Cadillac "This Time" (Seattle private press, low). ASK: label/catalog # and runout matrix of Heroin and SD (original vs reissue), vinyl grade, and $35 for the pair shipped Media Mail. At $35 + ~$8 in, resale ~$160 -> profit ~$85 (Tier B). Kill if reissues.

finds.title: Vintage Whitman's Chocolates two sided store sign
finds.note: Whitman's Chocolates painted wood double-sided hanging store sign, 34x8x5/8 in, messenger-boy logo + (R) mark; clean graphics could be 1970s-90s promo or repro. Ask: photos of back/edges/hanger holes for age wear and any maker/printer mark, and whether seller will ship or meet. At $20 only works if genuine pre-1960 (~$120-175 resale; profit ~$50-75 after ~$40 two-way ship of a 34in flat box).

finds.title: HUMMEL COLLECTION 17
finds.note: 17 genuine Goebel Hummels, seller says no chips; seller list claims ~11 full-bee TMK-2 (Brother 95, Trumpet Boy 97, Wayside Harmony 111, Doctor 127, Little Cellist 89/I, Auf Wiedersehen 153/0, Little Thrifty 118, Girl with Geese 47 3/0, Apple Tree Boy 142 3/0, Schoolboy 82 x3), rest later marks (Bashful 377 is TMK-5+). Est. lot $400-550 split (full bee ~$35-60 each). At $195 FIRM: profit ~$400x0.87-35-35-195 = ~$85 < $195 price -> fails. ASK: base photos showing TMK on each piece (confirm full bee/any crown); counter $120 (passes at $120: profit ~$160). Low odds seller budges.

finds.title: Vintage Film Cameras and Accessories
finds.note: Tier A: Nikon F2 Photomic (black) median $228 + Polaroid SX-70 Sonar median $125 + Falcon Special, Brownies, Spartus, Candela meter, projector; est resale ~$550; ~$375 profit. Local pickup (Mesquite, DFW). Ask which lenses are included.

finds.title: Antique Wooden Statue
finds.note: Tier A: 25.25in carved polychrome gilt santo (Nino Jesus), title "Antique Wooden Statue". Carved santos >=$150 sold $200-1,450 (median ~$275-365). ~$215 profit after ~$50 shipping.

finds.title: Antique Brass Andirons
finds.note: Tier B: Pair Louis XV rococo gilt-bronze chenets w/ log bars, listed as brass andirons. Chased pairs sold $797-1,195; plain brass pairs $250-300. ~$180 profit if gilt bronze; ask height + back casting.

finds.title: Hoyt Ultratec with XT3000 (2 sets) and accesories
finds.note: Tier A: Hoyt UltraTec + spare XT3000 limbs, sights, case; needs strings (~$30). UltraTec median $200 + limbs $60-120. ~$140 profit. Ask to ship (~$35).

finds.title: Original full-size Furbys
finds.note: Tier B: Eight 1998 Tiger Furbys 70-800 new in box, $10 each. NIB median $50 each -> ~$400; ~$130 profit after shipping. Ask box-front photos.

finds.title: Huge Cymbal Bundle – Zildjian / Paiste / Sabian – Below Market Price!
finds.note: Tier C: Zildjian 23in A Sweet Ride (median $380) + 7 more cymbals. Only works if $123 is the whole bundle AND they ship from Maui (~$100). ~$290 profit if so.

finds.title: Vintage Music Box
finds.note: Tier C: Thorens AD30 + 23 discs listed as "Vintage Music Box". Box median $130 + discs ~$150. Clears at a $75 offer (~$100 profit).

finds.title: 1901 hamilton pocket watch
finds.note: Hamilton open-face pocket watch, Arabic dial with 'Hamilton' script, gold-filled-looking case, seller says 1901 and running, $100 obo. A common GF Hamilton sells $100-180 = no profit. Ask for movement photo: buy at <= $100 only if grade 992/992B (or 940/21j) or the case is stamped 10K/14K.

finds.title: Large Antique Steam Gauge
finds.note: Ashton Valve Co. Boston 10.5 in brass 'Standard Test Gage' 0-500 psi, missing glass, red-painted back. No entry or comps. Large brass test gauges sell to steampunk/industrial buyers ~$100-200, but ship is heavy (~$25 each way): 150*0.87-25-25-25=55, passes only near $150. Ask weight and whether the needle and movement are intact; offer $20. Low confidence until sold comps are checked

finds.title: Old Coleman Empire Lantern
finds.note: Nickel-plated fount, red ventilator, red valve knob, fretwork burner guard, Pyrex globe; title says 'Coleman Empire'. Fount bottom photo shows no readable stamp. If it is a 1930s-40s nickel 242/243 class lantern, it sells $125-300 and $15 clears the bar (125*0.87-20-20-15=54). Ask: model and date stamp on the fount bottom or decal, globe logo, holds pressure. Buy at $15 if a nickel 242/243 or pre-1952

finds.title: Antique Russian Porcelain Coffee/Tea Server circa 1920s
finds.note: 8.75in Kuznetsov-type Rybinsk/USSR porcelain kumgan ewer made for the Central Asian/Middle East market c.1917-20s: cobalt flow ground, gilt stars, hand-painted rose reserve, stopper intact, seller says no chips. Asking $125; need resale ~$200 -> max buy ~$70. Ask for photo of the blue overglaze stamp and confirm no repair; offer $70. Profit at $70 = 200*.87-15-15-70 = ~$74.

finds.title: Blindstitch Embroidery 2 Pieces in Frames
finds.note: Two framed Chinese silk satin-stitch embroidered panels on blue silk (one a purse/pouch face, one a figural court-lady panel with peony/butterfly), late Qing–Republic c.1900-30, small frames (~10x12). Fine stitching, faded but intact. Seller asks $1/"make a fair offer". Offer $40 for both; ask for back-of-frame photo, sizes, any stains/holes. Resale ~$60-90 each unframed/framed on eBay -> ~$150 pair; profit at $40 = 150*.87-20-15-40 = ~$55.

finds.title: VINTAGE WREATH BROACH AND EARRINGS BY SHERMAN
finds.note: Sherman (Canada) peach/pink aurora borealis navette wreath brooch and earrings, 1960s from T. Eaton; large Sherman sets sell $100-200 (no comp). At $100 no margin; entry buy rule is Sherman parures under $50. Ask for photo of the SHERMAN signature on brooch back and earring clips, and offer $50

finds.title: Gold, Sterling Silver, Pearls...WOW !
finds.note: 14k-stamped "C" initial ring, pierced lattice shank (photos), est 1.5-2.5 g = ~$100-180 melt; plus sterling magnifier + long pearls; seller says MAKE AN OFFER. Ask gram weight of the ring and confirm the 14k stamp (not 14KP/GF); offer $40 for the ring alone

finds.title: Kalo Shop sterling silver bracelet
finds.note: Terapeak: Kalo sterling bracelets median $240 (n=16, bangles $86-92, leaf bracelet $365). At $199 fails; offer $110 → ~$70 profit if it is a substantial piece. Tier C.

finds.title: Hiro Yamagata Limited Edition Signed Serigraphs
finds.note: Terapeak: Hiro Yamagata serigraphs sold median $750 (n=15, p25 $300). Three signed/numbered framed serigraphs at "make offer, will accept ridiculously low". Even at $300 each × 3 and a $150 offer: ~$630 profit → Tier A. Ask: edition/condition photos, confirm all three, offer $100–150.

finds.title: ZAP COMIC FIRST Edition
finds.note: Terapeak: Zap #1 median $75, Donahue edition sold $80 (Jan 2026), p75 $210. Only a 1st printing clears; a 2nd printing is ~$80-200. At $50: ask for back cover; buy only if Plymell/Charles Plymell 25¢ first.

finds.title: vintage train collection
finds.note: Terapeak: 6520 searchlight car sells ~$16, 3462 milk car $25 — the lot is worth ~$120-180 not $250. At $50 profit ≈ $60 only if they run. Tier C now; offer $40 max.

finds.title: WWII US M3 CASE 1943 KNIFE
finds.note: WWII US M3 trench knife, stacked-leather grip, steel cross guard, sold with a Pacific-island wood/brass souvenir dagger for $100 both. Blade heavily pitted, no M8 scabbard, maker mark NOT shown. Only a crisp "U.S. M3 CASE" ricasso mark (Case made M3s in 1943 only, blade-marked, a scarce maker) lifts it; pitted guard-marked Imperial/Camillus examples are $80-120. Ask: close-up of the ricasso mark both sides; offer $50 for the M3 alone. No comp — low end.

finds.title: Vintage Patty Hearst Tania SLA Poster
finds.note: 1974 'TANIA' Patty Hearst SLA halftone poster 16x22, toned newsprint, pin holes, shrink-wrapped to board — originals sold $150-300, reprints $20. ASK: offer $50; photo of paper edge/back to confirm thin toned 1974 newsprint stock (coarse dot screen), not glossy later reprint; confirm shipping
